name: Wayfair
summary:
Wayfair is the furniture shop at wayfair.com. Its tab icon is the purple mark on product and registry pages, taken from the files that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against wayfair.com. HTML came from https://www.wayfair.com/ (HTTP 429). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.wayfair.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 17542 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 24×24, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 24×24, 32×32, 48×48.
